text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road worries that she lacks the 
"mental weapon" her two rivals possess. 
So, the Trainer pays a visit to a former 
mentor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her former mentor, watching Narita Top 
Road train, speaks. Not everyone has the 
strength to keep pushing forward. That is 
why she earns everyone's cheers, turning 
them into her strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer conveys their mentor's advice 
to Narita Top Road in their own words. 
Thanks to this, she was able to gain the 
power to believe in herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hoping to show her Trainer their glorious 
ideals come to life— Carrying the 
Trainer's expectations on her shoulders, 
Narita Top Road heads onto the stage of 
the Chrysanthemum!
